title: TorontoXP Sports Activity Finder
description: A full-stack application that helps Toronto residents discover sports activities at community centres. Built with React, Vite, and AWS Lambda, featuring real-time schedule data and smart filtering.
highlights: Brings Toronto community-centre sports activities into one discovery experience.
Uses schedule data and filters to help visitors narrow down activities.
Built with React, Vite, and AWS Lambda.

title: Fine-Tuned and Deployed a Custom LLM
description: Fine-tuned Qwen 3.5 9B with MLX on Apple Silicon to generate sarcastic conversational responses, then published the model to Hugging Face.
overview: Used LoRA fine-tuning with the MLX framework on Apple Silicon to adapt Qwen 3.5 9B for sarcastic conversational responses.
Packaged and published the resulting model on Hugging Face for inference and distribution.
highlights: Monitored and analyzed training metrics throughout LoRA fine-tuning.
Tracked memory utilization and performance characteristics on Apple Silicon.
Published the fine-tuned model for others to access on Hugging Face.

title: Identity Evolution Lab
description: An interactive showcase that traces modern identity and access management from passwords and sessions through MFA, tokens, OAuth, SSO, passkeys, and authorization.
overview: Identity Evolution Lab is a frontend-only visual simulation. Visitors follow a fictional employee through the layers of a modern identity system and see how authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, and federation work together.
It demonstrates concepts rather than providing a production identity service. Credentials, cryptographic checks, redirects, and WebAuthn ceremonies are illustrative browser-side interactions.
highlights: An interactive journey covers password sign-in, TOTP, JWTs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, passkeys, and permissions.
A playground compares authentication and authorization outcomes, including 200, 401, and 403 responses.
Architecture views and an audit inspector connect individual actions to the wider identity system.

title: IntQRac
description: An independent QR-assisted Interac e-Transfer concept that makes a recipient alias scannable and lets a mock banking app resolve and review the payee before a simulated transfer.
overview: IntQRac explores a faster way to start an e-Transfer to a first-time or one-time payee. A QR code carries an email address or Canadian phone number and can optionally pre-fill an amount, message, and reference. The sender's banking app remains responsible for resolving the recipient and presenting the final review step.
The frontend-only prototype uses a local mock Autodeposit service and fictional banking data. It does not connect to Interac or move money.
highlights: Generates and scans real QR images using an experimental ietqr://pay format.
Validates QR data, resolves the recipient through a mock Autodeposit lookup, and shows the verified name before the sender continues.
Simulates payment review and compares the concept with existing Canadian payment experiences.

title: Ping2Peer

highlights: Explores direct chat between peers in a decentralized network.
Built with JavaScript and browser local storage.

title: Telugu Lessa
description: Telugu Lessa is an effort to reinforce fundamentals and carry forward the legacy of Telugu language.
